temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt for several days; when Keith asks, she says she is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stuff, apologizing if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, her explanation changes his belief: her curtness is not about anger toward him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and respectful of her personal stress while remaining open to supporting her if appropriate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith learns Elizabeth accepts his offer of support and a coffee break; she thanks him and says it sounds good.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him, and he feels sympathetic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, her acceptance shows she welcomes his support and is willing to spend time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He believes Elizabeth is receptive to his support and that a coffee break can be a helpful way to be there for her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To use the coffee break to listen and offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; she has thought about professional help but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believes Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is receptive to his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, learning the severity and her hesitation changes his belief: she may need professional help, but she is unsure about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He believes professional help could benefit Elizabeth, but he is concerned that suggesting it might offend or overwhelm her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and worried about overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage professional help carefully while respecting her hesitation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After his suggestion, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn; when he apologizes, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believes Elizabeth may benefit from professional help but is hesitant; he is already concerned about how his suggestion landed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: her withdrawal makes him think he embarrassed or overstepped, but her reassurance then corrects that, showing she was not offended and is processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He believes Elizabeth was not offended by his suggestion; she appreciates his concern but is still thinking things over.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and guilty, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, avoid pushing, and remain supportive while she processes.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Following their last conversation, Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she says his support means a lot and she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believes Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is still processing her stress and his suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, her openness and thanks confirm she values his support and feels more comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He believes Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks together.
